notes: Usage footer reads Aliax's accounts: the footer shows the pinned account with a bar per usage window (percent left, on-pace tick, refill countdown, how many other accounts still have room) and its name opens a list of every saved account to switch with one click; the server builds the snapshot from Aliax's shared vault through aliax-core, follows Aliax's settings and usage cache, and falls back to the CLI's own sign-in when there is no vault. The old per-provider usage fetch is gone.
